title: 24-hour urine collection
what: You collect all your urine for 24 hours in one container. This shows the doctor how much protein, salts, and other substances leave your body in a day.
why: For kidney disease, protein in the urine, kidney stones, pregnancy, and diabetes.
duration: collecting takes exactly 24 hours; results usually take 1 to 3 days
tell_doctor: What medicines you take, especially water pills
If you have your period. The collection is usually moved

prepare.title: Container
prepare.text: Get a large clean container for 24-hour urine from your clinic or a pharmacy, usually 2 to 3 liters.

prepare.title: Routine
prepare.text: Drink as usual, not more and not less. Check with your clinic if you need to change what you eat.

prepare.title: Medicines
prepare.text: Do not stop your medicines. If you take water pills, tell your doctor and they will decide.

prepare.title: Plan
prepare.text: Choose a day when you will be at home. Missing even one portion ruins the test.

bring: All the collected urine, or part of it, as your clinic says
A note with the total urine volume for the day, and your height and weight if asked
steps: In the morning, pass your first urine into the toilet and note the time
After that, collect all your urine for the day in the container
Keep the container closed in a cool place, usually the fridge
Collect the last portion the next morning at the same time
Measure the total volume and write it down
Hand in all the urine or a mixed portion, as your clinic said
feel: Nothing. It is just collecting urine
after: You can go back to your usual routine right away
Your doctor will explain the result

faq.q: Do I collect the first morning urine?
faq.a: No. On the first day, it goes into the toilet and you note the time. But the first morning urine of the next day is collected.

faq.q: What if I missed one portion?
faq.a: It is better to start again on another day. Otherwise the result will be wrong.

reminders.text: Tomorrow morning you start the 24-hour urine collection. Get a clean container ready and make room in the fridge.
The 24-hour urine collection ends soon. Remember to collect the last morning portion and write down the total volume.
